name: auto-visio-helper
description: Auto Visio Helper — plan, generate, reproduce, and refine editable Microsoft Visio scientific diagrams. Converts a natural-language method description, paper screenshot, or hand-drawn sketch into a reviewable JSON drawing spec first, then renders the confirmed spec into an editable .vsdx via local Visio COM automation (scripts/render_visio.py), keeping shapes, connectors, text, layers, and groups fully editable. Ships references, demos, a reusable Visio template, and preview/export tooling.
